records.rule: Social media is mediated publish/receive/share/reply/recommend/discuss across platforms and off-network communities.
Keep platform, account, surface and item identity distinct.
A capability offer or provider registration is never an authorization to publish.
The strict facade is opt-in in dev6; public lower-level service access is an identified safety defect for live use.
Inbound raw proof and normalized event identity must bind; mutable metadata is insufficient.
Never repost an uncertain result or reuse a request ID with changed content.
Development file journal is not fsync/multiwriter/power-loss safe.
Acknowledged, accepted or queued is not delivered.
A reaction is an observed interaction, not proved brand benefit or causality.
Paid placements are proposed only; do not infer a ChatGPT ad-buying API.
Live rollout requires the estate API Client, identity, secret and durable journal authorities.
ZIP structure, static checks and a Git branch do not prove interpreter qualification or acceptance.
